shell_ops:
.btn,.select,.field{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--text);border-radius:9px;font-size:12px}.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:34px;padding:8px 11px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;text-decoration:none}.btn,.device-btn,.tab,.mini-action,.file-trash,summary{transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease,background-color .12s ease}.pressed{transform:translateY(1px) scale(.96);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(35,39,43,.22);filter:brightness(.94)}.btn:hover{background:#f8faf8}.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}.btn.ghost{background:#fff}.btn.full{width:100%}.btn.compact{min-height:30px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px}.icon-btn{min-width:40px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:17px;line-height:1}.btn:focus-visible,.device-btn:focus-visible,.dropzone:focus-visible,.file-item-main:focus-visible,.tab:focus-visible,.mini-action:focus-visible,.field:focus,.select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.select{height:31px;padding:5px 8px}.field{width:100%;padding:8px 9px}.row{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}.row>*{min-width:0}.section-title{margin:10px 0 6px}.file-input{position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
